item.title: Quran Verse Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:72 | Quran Ayah with English Translation
item.description: "Those who say, “Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary,” have certainly fallen into disbelief. The Messiah [himself] said, “O Children of Israel!
